id.description: Unique row ID, used for the recipient checkbox and action menu.

subtitle.description: Supporting context or contact description. Wraps rather than truncating.

preview.description: Optional last-message preview. Truncated visually to one line.

href.description: Navigation URL. Omit for an enhancement-driven button.

conversationId.description: Conversation ID for navigation and action events.

participantId.description: Contact ID for navigation, recipient selection, and action events.

formId.description: Form associated with the recipient checkbox.

avatarProps.description: Avatars to display; multiple entries use AvatarGroup. Omit href on avatars inside the row control.

actions.description: Optional host-defined directory actions. Omit or pass [] to hide the menu. Actions dispatch usx:chat-directory-action; the host controls availability and effects.

selectable.description: Render a recipient checkbox instead of a Clickable. Supply participantId for its value.
